ARTC 100.title: Arts Co-op Search Term #1
ARTC 100.description: Search term to obtain first work term. Completion of pre-employment workshops, group and individual coaching sessions on job search processes, and minimum number of job applications required. Students apply for jobs and go for interviews until they are hired. Pass/Fail. Restricted to students in the Arts Co-op Program.
notes: Completion of Writing Component of Arts Writing and Research Requirement strongly recommended.

ARTC 110.title: Arts Co-op Work Term #1
ARTC 110.description: Approved and supervised work experience with a non-profit, public or private organization for a minimum of 12 weeks and/or 420 hours full-time. Reflective assignments required. Restricted to students in the Arts Co-operative Education Program. Pass/Fail. Recommended prerequisite: ARTC_V 100. Recommended corequisite: ARTC_V 110 can be taken at the same time as ARTC_V 200.

Recommended pre-requisite: ARTC_V 110 Recommended co-requisite: ARTC_V 110 can be taken at the same time as ARTC_V 200.
